subject: Follow-up: Pricing & committed-use options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@sparkchat.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Pricing & committed-use options

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put together a formal quote:

- Recap from the call: SparkChat is planning to migrate message generation + ranking to Redwood for the customer-facing chat flows. Expected prod traffic in Q4: ~150M tokens/month (avg), with spikes around campaign events.
- Primary goal: keep cost predictable while maintaining sub-200ms 95th pct latency for user-facing generation.
- Important: team is evaluating committed-use vs on-demand hosted pricing; also interested in multi-year incentives and whether startup credits apply.

Could you confirm the following so I can model unit economics and recommended committed tiers:
1) Expected monthly active tokens (avg and peak month). If you have a 90/10 or P95 estimate that helps.
2) Target monthly budget range for inference (ballpark is fine).
3) Any procurement constraints (PO / prepay / term length preference).

High-level next steps from our side once we get the numbers: I will draft a proposal with 3 committed tiers (6mo, 12mo, 24mo) and show per-1M token unit economics plus the startup program credit option.

If easier, reply to this thread with the numbers or drop the traffic CSV.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Solutions (Redwood Inference)
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Alex Johnson <alex@sparkchat.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing & committed-use options

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming numbers below and attaching last quarter's export.

- Current projection (prod go-live Q4):
  - Avg monthly tokens: ~150M (message generation + ranking combined)
  - Peak month (marketing campaigns): ~240M tokens
  - P95 per-request token length ~1.2k tokens
- Budget range: $15k - $25k / month initially (we can expand with proven ROI)
- Procurement: Prefer 12-month term if pricing incentives are material; we can do prepay for a discount but need legal review.

We're a Seed-stage startup — any startup program credits or first-year incentives will meaningfully impact our decision. Curious what committed-use discounts you typically bucket at for this volume and whether multi-year (2yr) pricing is meaningfully different.

Attaching: sparkchat_traffic_2026Q2.csv

— Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering, SparkChat Inc.
alex@sparkchat.io

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@sparkchat.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing & committed-use options

Alex — great, thanks for the numbers and the CSV. Attached is a short proposal stub so you and your procurement team have something to review. High-level economics below (hosted API pricing used as baseline):

- Baseline (on-demand hosted): $20 / 1M tokens (estimate for relevant model family + streaming)
- 6-month committed-use (prepay or monthly commit): 20% discount → $16 / 1M tokens
- 12-month committed-use: 30% discount → $14 / 1M tokens
- 24-month / multi-year: 35-40% discount (volume & prepay dependent) → ~$12-$13 / 1M tokens
- Startup program: eligible for a $10k credit + an additional 10% off first-year committed pricing (if accepted into the program)

Given your avg of 150M tokens/mo, ballpark monthly costs under those tiers:
- On-demand: $3,000 / month (note: this is illustrative; per-1M numbers scale) — sorry, correcting math — on-demand at $20/1M for 150M = $3,000? (This was a mis-typed example; see formal proposal PDF for exact numbers).
- 12-month at $14/1M = $2,100 / month (before startup credit)

Action items / next steps:
1) I attached redwood_proposal_sparkchat_v1.pdf that lays out 3 committed tiers (6/12/24), estimated monthly cost lines for the 150M avg and the 240M peak, and the legal/PO requirements for prepay.
2) If you want, we can include an additional 5% commercial incentive if SparkChat signs a 12-month prepay within 2 weeks (requires approval from sales ops). Ben is looped for that approval path.
3) Let me know if you'd like a formal quote (DocuSign) — I can push the quote to HubSpot (DEAL-4582).

Quick note on unit economics: if your target is ~$10 / 1M tokens, we'd need a multi-year + prepay committment at the high end of the volume band; I can show scenarios in the formal quote.

Thanks — I'll wait for your procurement preference (term + prepay yes/no) and confirm whether you want to apply for the startup program.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Solutions (Redwood Inference)
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132
Attachment: redwood_proposal_sparkchat_v1.pdf
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4582

Marissa — noted. I pulled finance and sales-ops into a quick thread (separately) — for visibility: we can approve the suggested 5% flywheel incentive on a 12-month prepay but will need a signed SOW + prepay confirmation before the discount is committed.
